items.title: AlphaGo’s Move 37 Wasn’t Creative? | Edward Hughes
items.summary:
Edward Hughes argues that AlphaGo’s Move 37 was innovative, but creativity requires another step: recognising the value of what you have done. In his account, that recognition came from the human commentators.

Watch the full conversation on Machine Learning Street Talk:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P4bYjTJvD28

#Shorts #AlphaGo #AI #Creativity

items.title: 🔴 LIVE: India Drives BRICS Tech Agenda | OpenAI Launches ChatGPT for Financial Services | Front Page
items.summary:
India has placed artificial intelligence, semiconductor manufacturing, shared compute infrastructure, Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), and cross-border payments at the center of the BRICS technology cooperation agenda. In global AI announcements, OpenAI launched ChatGPT for Financial Services powered by its GPT-6 Astra model alongside Morgan Stanley and Evercore, while Anthropic accused Chinese AI labs of massive data extraction from Claude, and former researcher Jacob Coxon warned of existential AI risks. Domestically, 51% of Indian government teachers are using AI tools ahead of formal policy, NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang defended his $4 trillion AI spending forecast, Bosch SDS partnered with Dassault Systèmes for industrial smart manufacturing, Bengaluru's C-CAMP planned a ₹400-crore Innovation Park, Wipro unlocked capacity equivalent to 20,000 workers via AI, Primebook co-founder Chitranshu Mahant and Ziroh Labs CEO Hrishikesh Dewan join us live.

This is your Front Page LIVE, bringing you sharp analysis of the biggest technology, business, policy and economic stories shaping India and the world.
